verdict.rationale: Granola stores meeting notes/transcripts and lets users search or chat with past notes (via Chat or MCP's 'search through your meeting notes, find specific topics discussed in past meetings'), and it connects to your calendar to show upcoming meetings, which together could support manual meeting prep. However, there is no evidence of an automatic pre-call brief or a feature that proactively surfaces past meetings with the same attendees before a call starts — the burden is on the user to search/chat manually. Missing for 10: automatic surfacing of past meetings by attendee tied to calendar events, a dedicated pre-meeting briefing/open-threads summary feature, and any first-hand account of this proactive workflow.
